description: This bar chart illustrates the NDCG@10 values for different interaction types. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”, presented in an unspecified order and rotated for readability. The vertical axis, labeled “NDCG@10”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.25 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. Three bars are displayed, each representing a different interaction type; the first, labeled “- critiquing”, is orange and extends to approximately 0.21; the second, labeled “- scoring”, is blue and extends to approximately 0.19; the third, labeled “- ranking”, is also blue and extends to approximately 0.12, and a fourth, unlabeled bar is gray and extends to approximately 0.06. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart includes a legend indicating the gray bar represents a category not explicitly labeled on the horizontal axis.
